hero.question: Will Ian Buck be the next CEO of NVIDIA?
hero.prob_take: At 15.5%, the crowd is pricing Buck as a real but unlikely successor to Jensen Huang, and the 13-point drop in 24 hours suggests fresh skepticism about his path to the top job. Buck runs NVIDIA's biggest division by revenue (data center), but Jensen has shown zero interest in stepping down, and the board would likely reach outside the company before promoting an internal rival to the COO.

hero_trending.question: Howard Lutnick out as Secretary of Commerce by December 31?
hero_trending.prob_take:
At 49.5%, the market is basically coin-flipping on whether Lutnick survives his first year, which tells you the crowd has zero conviction after his rocky confirmation hearings and that one leaked comment about getting "Trump's ear" on tariffs.

The real tell is the 6-point drop in 24 hours, suggesting smart money is leaning NO because betting against a secretary of commerce typically requires either criminal indictment or a major policy disaster, and Lutnick has neither yet despite the noise.
